acceptanceCriteria: Root cause for the CfT 154 remote-browser connection failure is recorded (TestCafe, Chrome or adapter).
Either a working CfT 154 TestCafe witness or the limitation recorded in the spec with the exact tuple.
body: Found by CEM dynamic lane V1-0592 (PR beamfall/corvint#1003, head 1398a8c24, base origin/main 7c9a52d90, corvint build 615) on 2026-10-17. Evidence: /private/tmp/cem10-build/dynamic-2026-10-17/. TestCafe local-browser path is blocked by missing macOS Screen Recording permission; the remote-browser alternative with CfT 154 --headless=new never connected. TestCafe witnesses used chrome-headless-shell 153 instead. Related: V1-0605 (EEXIST helper).
title: TestCafe with Chrome for Testing 154 --headless=new never connects as a remote browser
